verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships AI features, such as AI mock generation and commit message suggestions, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question. The pack has no documented control or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. Related evidence (servers cannot read synced data, Git Sync keeps data in the user's repo) covers storage and encryption, not training use, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
